_comment: Example config for price_tracker.py. Copy this file to tracked.json and edit it with your own products.
_comment_discord_webhook: Shared default Discord webhook, used by any product below that doesn't set its own. Leave empty ('') to fall back to the DISCORD_WEBHOOK environment variable -- that's how the scheduled GitHub Actions workflow supplies it, via a repo secret. Never commit a real webhook URL here.

products._comment: Full example showing every supported key. Only 'name' and 'url' are required -- everything else below is optional.
products.name: Example Jacket
products._comment_name: Required. Human-readable product name, used in Discord messages and (lowercased/sanitized) as the default history filename.
products._comment_url: Required. Full product page URL to load and scrape.
products._comment_threshold: Optional. Sends a Discord alert when the price is at or below this value. If omitted, a Discord message is sent on every successful check instead.
products._comment_selectors: Optional. CSS selectors to try in order, most specific first. When given, these are used INSTEAD OF the built-in DEFAULT_SELECTORS (not merged with them). If omitted, DEFAULT_SELECTORS is used.
products._comment_discord_webhook: Optional. Per-product webhook that overrides the top-level discord_webhook for this product only. Leave empty ('') to use the top-level default (which itself may fall back to DISCORD_WEBHOOK).
products._comment_history_file: Optional. Path to the JSON file this product's price history is saved to. If omitted, it defaults to history_<name>.json, where <name> is the product's 'name' lowercased with any character that isn't a letter, digit, underscore or hyphen replaced by '_' -- e.g. 'Example Jacket' -> history_example_jacket.json.

products._comment: Minimal example -- only the required keys.
products.name: Example Product
